assets.theme: Carbon Transfer Paper with Irregular Graphite Impressions
assets.palette: graphite black, warm bone, soft charcoal, muted ivory
assets.prompt: Create a reusable analog transfer texture for an editorial book cover designer, also suitable for experimental event poster artwork. Show a single unprinted cream paper sheet carrying irregular graphite-black carbon transfer impressions from an unseen pressure process. Fine dark powder lodges in porous paper fibers, with soft rubbed areas, minute interrupted lines, delicate pressure streaks, and scattered gray dust impressions. Avoid readable writing, symbols, illustrations, stationery props, and broad generic grunge splatters. Compose a horizontal 16:9 straight-on macro photograph of the continuous sheet, extending beyond every edge. Concentrate the denser carbon transfer on the lower right and outer border, leaving the left third gently marked and low contrast for later typography. Keep a physically credible distribution of abrasion and porous ink uptake, with no obvious repeat tiles. Art style: Archival Carbon Transfer Macro Photography, restrained black on warm bone, accurate fine paper grain and subtle real ink feathering. Use flat diffuse copy-stand illumination with delicate side relief, neutral archival mood. Deliver one original raster texture without logos, watermarks, lettering, false transparency, or artificial digital glitch effects.
assets.negative_prompt: legible words, carbon copy forms, handwriting, ink stamps, thick scratches, poster mockup

assets.theme: Folded Dichroic Foil with Controlled Spectral Highlights
assets.palette: smoky violet, silver graphite, muted cyan, warm pearl
assets.prompt: Produce a reusable optical-material background for a technology launch designer, suitable for a website hero and a keynote opening slide. Depict one large sheet of very thin dichroic polymer foil with a few carefully formed diagonal folds, gentle tension wrinkles, and physically plausible angle-dependent interference colors. The foil should reveal a restrained spectral shift from smoky violet to pale cyan and silver, with fine real microcreases and nuanced reflectance, avoiding shiny chrome liquid or fantastical light beams. Compose a horizontal 16:9 studio macro photograph, with the foil gathered and folded predominantly across the right forty percent. Preserve a softly illuminated, minimally detailed left half for externally added typography, allowing safe responsive crops and interface margins. The surface continues beyond the frame without separate props, devices, or packaging. Art style: Studio Optical Material Photography, thin-film diffraction, controlled edge reflections, and physically coherent fold shadows. Light with one large soft studio source and a narrow grazing accent that reveals the foil thickness and folds. Create an original, clean, high-resolution raster surface with no text, logos, watermarks, impossible transparency, or repeating gradient bands.

assets.theme: Frayed Linen Selvedge Across a Neutral Textile Plane

assets.prompt: Create a versatile textile-edge design component for a sustainable fashion brand designer, also useful for a craft workshop invitation. Photograph a single undyed linen cloth lying flat against a slightly darker natural-fiber backing. The cloth has a convincing plain weave with varied yarn thickness, tiny slubs, subtle tension, and one naturally frayed selvedge running vertically along the far left. Individual loose threads must follow the fabric weave and gravity realistically, with no lace motifs, stitched labels, scissors, clothing, or decorative objects. Keep the frayed edge within the left fifth, letting the uninterrupted neutral textile occupy the center and right as a calm field for future text and graphic placement. Protect the upper and lower interface margins for mobile story cropping.
